[[File:Taku Kuwabara.png|200px|thumb|right|Kuwabara's icon as of 2024[https://twitter.com/kwbrtk/photo Kuwabara's Twitter icon.]]] '''Taku Kuwabara''' (Japanese: '''桑原太矩''' ''Kuwabara Taku'', born May 20, 1985)[https://archive.is/5UAfo MAL, source of Kuwabara's birthday.] is a mangaka that has worked on the Pokémon series, as the writer and artist on [[Snorlax's Dream Gourmet]]. To commemorate the release, he posted his Master Ball Rank [[Rental Pokémon|rental team]] for players of [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]] to download and use in-game, which included a {{p|Snorlax}} holding an [[Assault Vest]].[https://archive.is/adOFe Kuwabara's rental team that he posted to commemorate the release of Snorlax's Dream Gourmet.] According to Kuwabara, the first game he ever played was [[Pokémon Red and Green Versions|Pokémon Red.]][https://archive.is/gWK4t Kuwabara confirming that his first Pokémon game was Pokémon Red.] ==Designs== ===Characters=== The following is a list of characters designed by Kuwabara. {|style="font-size:80%; margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border:2px solid #1a1a1a; background:#ebebeb; color:#000" | colspan="15" style="{{roundy|20px}} border:2px solid #{{black 2 color dark}}; background:#{{black 2 color dark}}; font-size:125%; color:white" | '''{{color|fff|Other}}''' |- | style="{{roundy|2px}} border:2px solid #{{black color dark}}; background:#{{black color light}}; height:100px; width:100px"| [[File:Kabigon's Dream Gourmet Kumura.png|x100px]] | style="{{roundy|2px}} border:2px solid #{{black color dark}}; background:#{{black color light}}; height:100px; width:100px"| [[File:Kabigon's Dream Gourmet Kamni.png|x100px]] |- | '''{{color2|000|Snorlax's Dream Gourmet}}'''
